title: FaceXBench: Evaluating Multimodal LLMs on Face Understanding

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the accuracy and consistency of multimodal LLMs on multiple-choice visual question answering tasks involving age estimation from facial images to ensure predictions remain unbiased regardless of the subject's age group.

Evaluating the accuracy and consistency of multimodal LLMs on multiple-choice visual question answering tasks involving gender prediction from facial images to ensure predictions remain unbiased regardless of the subject's gender.

Evaluating the accuracy and consistency of multimodal LLMs on multiple-choice visual question answering tasks involving race estimation from facial images to ensure predictions remain unbiased regardless of the subject's racial background.
